agentModules.title: Agent modules and hardware providers
agentModules.help: Uploaded packages and installations on devices. Disabled is not uninstalled. Package deletion is separate from device removal.
agentModules.manage: Configure and install hardware providers in Devices
agentModules.unavailable: Agent inventory is unavailable. Previously loaded rows may be stale.
agentModules.unconfirmed: Removal was refused or is unconfirmed. Refresh status; do not submit a replacement request.
agentModules.pending: Removal is pending or unconfirmed. Keep the original request; do not replace it.
agentModules.empty: No Agent packages or recorded installations.
agentModules.missing: Package missing. The recorded installation remains visible and can still be removed from its device.
agentModules.uploaded: No current device installation references this package version
agentModules.upgrade: Update this Agent to support confirmed full removal.
agentModules.removeHelp: Stops this provider and permanently removes all its versions, saved profile and local module data from this device. It does not erase other modules, command receipts, the I²C host configuration or application data. The LCD may retain its last frame.
agentModules.offline: An offline or unconfirmed device stays listed until its Agent confirms removal. Dependent applications lose this provider; they are not silently rebound.
agentModules.deleteHelp: Permanently delete this uploaded package only after all devices have confirmed full removal. Other versions are not deleted.
agentModules.acknowledge: I reviewed the exact package, device and data to remove.

remoteAgentUpdates.title: Remote Node Agents
remoteAgentUpdates.help: Update one Node through its signed OTA mechanism. Core is not updated. This uses the supported published ARMv6 Node package, including its Agent and Node service files; it is not a local native-host build.
remoteAgentUpdates.safety: The Node must have signed-update support, the pinned Hub identity, fresh state and no conflicting physical commands. Its installer preserves device identity and data and verifies health or rollback. Unsupported profiles are refused, not upgraded by guessing.
remoteAgentUpdates.unavailable: Node status is unavailable. Read the original operation; do not repeat installation.
remoteAgentUpdates.empty: No approved remote Node devices are registered.
remoteAgentUpdates.prepare: Download and prepare on this Node
remoteAgentUpdates.catalogUnavailable: No supported published Node package was confirmed. Check the Node profile and its pinned Hub identity.
remoteAgentUpdates.notInstalled: Not confirmed; a queued command is not installed software.
remoteAgentUpdates.unconfirmed: Result unconfirmed. Read status; installation is never automatically repeated.
remoteAgentUpdates.confirmHelp: Restart this Node Agent through the verified Node installer. Temporary disconnection is expected. No bulk update, Core restart, device reset or new application rights.
remoteAgentUpdates.changed: The reviewed operation changed. Close and review again.
remoteAgentUpdates.acknowledge: I approve this exact device, release and package hash.
remoteAgentUpdates.override: I explicitly approve installation outside the maintenance window.

componentUpdates.refused: Not accepted; no update was scheduled. Refresh and review the current state.
componentUpdates.title: Agent and application hosts
componentUpdates.help: Prepare from this installed Core, then separately approve an exact component build. No downloads or dependency installation.
componentUpdates.boundary: Only the selected component restarts. Core, Runtime, other host pins, the default host, applications, data and rights remain unchanged. An Agent restart briefly interrupts its capabilities.
componentUpdates.consent: Saved application consent may resume hardware output after reconnecting. This page does not grant rights or invoke Start/Send.
componentUpdates.unavailable: Component status is unavailable. Other administration remains available.
componentUpdates.unconfirmed: Outcome unconfirmed. Preserve the request ID and read status; do not resend.
componentUpdates.same: This build is already selected. No update is needed.
componentUpdates.stale: The reviewed component or Core changed. Prepare a fresh candidate.
componentUpdates.confirmRecovery: Reconcile the interrupted transaction and check this component. This can restart it but never replays an update or application operation.
componentUpdates.confirmSwitch: Switch only this component to the exact build below. Failed health checks must restore the previous build or leave an explicit recovery-required result.
componentUpdates.reviewChanged: The reviewed state changed. Close and review it again.
componentUpdates.acknowledge: I reviewed this exact target, build and temporary interruption.
componentUpdates.override: I explicitly approve switching outside the maintenance window.

reason.candidate_prepared: Candidate prepared. The running component has not changed.
reason.component_updated: Updated and checked. Core stayed running.
reason.component_recovered: Interrupted operation reconciled; update was not replayed.
reason.preparation_failed: Preparation failed; no switch requested. Installed dependencies must match the Core lock.
reason.previous_component_ready: Operation failed; previous component is confirmed ready.
reason.component_outcome_unconfirmed: Outcome unconfirmed. Explicit recovery is required.
reason.worker_interrupted: Worker interrupted. Review recovery; do not repeat the update.

hardwareProfiles.title: Hardware providers
hardwareProfiles.help: Review the exact device, package and hardware profile before installation. This is not an application permission.
hardwareProfiles.uploadFailed: Upload was not confirmed. Refresh the catalog before trying again; no provider was activated by upload.
hardwareProfiles.unavailable: Current status is unavailable. No approval or readiness is confirmed.
hardwareProfiles.unconfirmed: Outcome unavailable or unconfirmed. Refresh status; do not repeat the request.
hardwareProfiles.unsupported: The Agent has not advertised hardware-profile approval support. Update Agent before installation.
hardwareProfiles.empty: No provider package is prepared. Configure a supported provider above or upload an existing package.
hardwareProfiles.setupHelp: Choose the driver and actual hardware settings. Preparation only adds an immutable package to the catalog; review and installation are separate.
hardwareProfiles.setupLimits: PCF8574T uses HD44780 with the reviewed backpack pin mapping. Two rows support up to 40 columns; four rows up to 20. The address is not detected automatically. Check wiring and voltage separately.
hardwareProfiles.replacementHelp: Changing the settings creates a different provider. Disable the previous provider before installing its replacement, then review the application's display binding separately.
hardwareProfiles.invalidConfiguration: Check the profile settings before preparation.
hardwareProfiles.prepared: Provider prepared. Nothing was installed or approved. Review the selected profile below to install it.
hardwareProfiles.prepareFailed: Provider preparation was refused or unconfirmed. Check the settings and refresh the catalog. No installation was requested.
hardwareProfiles.advancedUpload: Advanced: upload an existing provider package
hardwareProfiles.noIo: Installation does not scan the bus, send a display frame, grant application rights or reboot. Physical wiring is not verified by software.
hardwareProfiles.disableHelp: Disable this provider and prevent new capability execution. The physical display may retain its last contents.
hardwareProfiles.approveHelp: Approve this exact hardware profile and install/activate its provider on this device. No test frame is sent; application access still requires a separate M20 grant.
hardwareProfiles.acknowledge: I reviewed this exact device, package and hardware profile.

hardwareInterfaces.title: Hardware interfaces
hardwareInterfaces.help: Enable the host interface first. Providers and application permissions are separate approvals.
hardwareInterfaces.unavailable: Current status is unavailable. No readiness is confirmed.
hardwareInterfaces.unconfirmed: Outcome unconfirmed. Preserve the request ID; do not resubmit.
hardwareInterfaces.verificationFailed: Restart detected, but live I²C or Agent access was not verified
hardwareInterfaces.recovery: Outcome requires inspection; do not repeat the change
hardwareInterfaces.failed: Preparation failed; inspect the result before a new review
hardwareInterfaces.unsupported: This device or its host configuration is not supported by this I²C profile. No change was made.
hardwareInterfaces.agentUnavailable: The local Agent is not running; configuration is unavailable.
hardwareInterfaces.noIo: This does not scan the bus, write to the display or approve an application.
hardwareInterfaces.restartRequested: Restart requested. Reconnect after the device starts and refresh status; do not repeat the request.
hardwareInterfaces.enableHelp: Prepare boot configuration, i2c-dev loading and an i2c supplementary group for the Agent service only. Applying does not restart the device.
hardwareInterfaces.electrical: Software does not verify wiring or signal voltage. Use electrically compatible hardware.
hardwareInterfaces.restartHelp: Restart this exact device now? Core and its local workloads will briefly be unavailable. This does not reset data, role or network configuration.
hardwareInterfaces.acknowledge: I have reviewed this exact device and change.

authorityReview.title: Permission request changes
authorityReview.warning: Declarations only, not approved access. Added or changed requests may expand authority. This snapshot can become stale; it never authorizes installation or actions.
authorityReview.unstable: The installation is changing or has an inconsistent version. Compare again after it settles.
authorityReview.unavailable: The installed baseline could not be verified. No comparison was made; this is not treated as a new installation.
authorityReview.notAvailable: This Core did not return an authority comparison.
authorityReview.configurationInvalid: The saved settings are incomplete or incompatible with this package.
authorityReview.frontendUnknown: Executable frontend effects cannot be determined from declarations.
authorityReview.peerUnknown: Approved peer scope is not available.
authorityReview.unresolvedScope: This scope could not be resolved.
authorityReview.noInstallation: No application installation exists. Showing new declarations; configuration remains unresolved.
authorityReview.savedConfiguration: Compared with the installed package, including a disabled installation. Saved settings are reused for the candidate preview only; nothing is saved.
authorityReview.artifactChanged: The artifact has changed. An empty permission diff would not make the new code trusted or approved.
authorityReview.noChanges: No declaration changes found. This is not permission approval.
authorityReview.potentialExpansion: May expand access; requires review, not an automatic grant.
authorityReview.notChecked: Approved grants, device availability/contracts, stored connector bindings and credential rotations, publisher/signature trust, dependencies and OS/browser isolation are not checked.

data.title: How the application says it handles data
data.personal: The package declares that it stores personal data.
data.noPersonal: The package declares that it does not store personal data.
data.boundary: These are declarations, not verified behavior or grants. Inspection does not export or erase anything. Local erasure does not remove downloaded backups or external copies.

packageInspection.title: Package inspection
packageInspection.help: Read-only review of manifest-v2 ZIP packages. No installation or code execution; legacy packages are not supported here.
packageInspection.sizeLimit: Choose a non-empty ZIP no larger than 10 MiB.
packageInspection.failed: The package could not be inspected. Nothing was installed.
packageInspection.new: New package — not in the catalog
packageInspection.exact: This exact package is already in the catalog
packageInspection.conflict: Version conflict — this ID/version has different contents in the catalog
packageInspection.warning: Publisher and signature are not verified. Dependencies and conflicts are declared, not resolved. Inspection is not approval and does not guarantee installation; uploading remains a separate action.
packageInspection.declarations: All declarations, configuration and runtime descriptors

fleetPairing.title: New devices
fleetPairing.help: Devices request access automatically after Wi-Fi setup. Add only a device you recognize. Names are supplied by the device.
fleetPairing.empty: No devices are waiting for approval.
fleetPairing.failed: The request could not be confirmed. Refresh and check its current state.
fleetPairing.approved: Device approved. It will connect automatically within about 30 seconds.

themePackages.manageHelp: Enable this version, then choose it in Settings → Theme Customization. Enabling does not change the selected theme.
themePackages.extensionsHelp: Upload, enable, disable and delete theme packages in Extensions.
themePackages.noneEnabled: No enabled themes are available. Built-in settings remain available.
themePackages.title: Installed themes
themePackages.help: The theme applies to this installation. Light/dark mode remains a separate preference. Header and menu settings are preserved.
themePackages.confirmDelete: Delete this theme version? An active theme will return to built-in settings.
themePackages.failed: The theme action failed. Refresh and check the package.
themePackages.uploaded: ZIP uploaded. Enable it, then select it to apply.
themePackages.tooLarge: The ZIP must be no larger than 10 MiB.
themePackages.unavailableHelp: Package missing or invalid. Built-in settings are used if it was selected.
themePackages.legacyHelp: Package colors are read-only. Choose built-in to edit your saved custom colors; they have not been erased.

settings.emptyHeaderMenuHelp: The header has no navigation links. Create a menu to choose links, or leave it empty. Settings remain available at /settings and through Ctrl+K.
settings.menuPublicRouteRequired: This route requires sign-in and cannot be exposed publicly.

sessionDuration.title: Signed-in session
sessionDuration.help: Choose how long this device remembers a signed-in browser. Active sessions renew automatically.
sessionDuration.label: Session duration (hours)

outgoingReports.title: Outgoing status reports
outgoingReports.help: Allow this exact application package to send only the selected fields to this receiver. An approval does not itself send a report.
outgoingReports.empty: No active v2 report links for this application.
outgoingReports.withdrawn: Sending permission withdrawn. A report already sent cannot be recalled.
outgoingReports.unavailable: This link could not be reviewed.
outgoingReports.uncertain: The change was not confirmed. Read the current link before making another decision.

incomingReports.title: Incoming status reports
incomingReports.help: Approve only a sender you recognize. This lets this application receive the listed status fields. It does not grant remote control.
incomingReports.empty: No verified requests are waiting for this application.
incomingReports.limited: Showing the first 32 requests by expiry.
incomingReports.expired: This request expired. Check pending requests again.
incomingReports.approved: Approval saved for the reviewed selection.
incomingReports.unavailable: Could not read the pending requests.
incomingReports.unconfirmed: Approval was not confirmed. Check the current requests before another decision.

peerReceipt.empty: No current recorded report for this application. This is not a delivery history.
peerReceipt.limited: Showing up to 16 references. You can also enter the original IDs below.
peerReceipt.title: Check an outgoing peer report
peerReceipt.help: Use the original IDs. This reads the local delivery record; it does not contact the other installation or resend the report.
peerReceipt.not_observed_in_scope: No matching record in the current slot. An older report may have been replaced; this does not prove non-delivery.
peerReceipt.outcome_unconfirmed: The original report was recorded, but no acknowledgement is stored. Do not assume it failed.
peerReceipt.acknowledged: This installation recorded the acknowledgement for that report. This is not a current connection check.
peerReceipt.unavailable: The stored receipt could not be verified.
peerReceipt.failed: Could not read the local receipt. Nothing was sent.
peerReceipt.noMore: No further current records. Use Find current report IDs to check again from the start.

support.trace: Trace a specific task or device command

workStates.notFound: No matching record in this scope. This does not prove non-execution.
workStates.delivered: Delivered; the outcome is not yet confirmed.

support.refHelp: Use an ID from the task or command history to include its recorded state in the download. This does not repeat it.
support.invalid: Use task_ or cmd_ followed by the 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or leave the field empty.
support.saved: Downloaded a fresh service reading and recent failures matched to this package. No application data or logs are included.
support.partial: Downloaded a partial report. Some observations were unavailable.
support.failed: Could not download diagnostics for this application. No action was repeated.

boundaries.no_dispatch_record: Core has no dispatch record for this task.
boundaries.dispatch_recorded: Core recorded dispatch, but not use of the start permit.
boundaries.start_permit_consumed: The worker used its start permit. That alone does not prove it finished.
boundaries.inconsistent: The stored start and dispatch records disagree.

support.notDeviceTime: This is not device execution time.
support.permitClaimed: Core recorded a one-use permit claim. This does not confirm a physical action.

support.queueTime: From queuing to the latest offer, approximately:

applicationLimits.scope: Limits for this service. A stricter visible group limit is shown below the service value. Group capacity is shared, not reserved. 100% CPU equals one logical processor.

hierarchy.noCap: No cap found in visible groups
hierarchy.incomplete: Could not verify the entire hierarchy; a lower limit may apply

policy.title: More limits and restart settings
policy.fds: Open files per main process (soft / hard)
policy.local: Private network; local Unix sockets only
policy.scope: Open-file limits are read from the running process. Restart, shutdown and network settings come from the service manager; they do not grant access to connectors.

service.title: Application service
service.hint: This is the current restart counter, not a history. A running service does not by itself confirm that the application works.

results.resources: System resource or service setup error
results.watchdog: Service stopped responding to its watchdog
results.start-limit-hit: Too many starts in a short time
results.oom-kill: Process killed due to memory pressure

applicationLimits.notSet: No limit set at this level
applicationLimits.notRunning: The service is not running. There are no live limits to show.
applicationLimits.restarting: The service is restarting. Refresh once it is running.
applicationLimits.noUnit: No system service was found for this installation.
applicationLimits.notInstalled: The application is no longer installed.
applicationLimits.unsupported: This host does not expose the required Linux resource controls.
applicationLimits.changed: The installation or its service changed. Refresh for a new reading.
applicationLimits.busy: Another resource check is in progress. Try again shortly.

systemControl.title: Device control
systemControl.description: Restart this Raspberry Pi or erase all persistent application data and return it to first-boot setup.
systemControl.restartHelp: Restarts the device. The application will be unavailable for a short time.
systemControl.restartQueued: Restart requested. Reconnect after the device starts again.
systemControl.resetDataWarning: Erases users, settings, installed applications and the Agent identity. If you need this data, download a recovery file to another device first.
systemControl.resetLan: On your usual network, use the Pi’s LAN IP in this address:
systemControl.resetAp: Only if setup Wi-Fi was configured and appears: join “3mm Setup XXXX”, then open
systemControl.resetFirstLogin: Create your administrator account in Setup, then sign in with its email and password.
systemControl.factoryConfirm: This permanently deletes all application data. Type FACTORY RESET to continue.
systemControl.resetAccepted: Reset requested. When Setup is ready, reconnect using the instructions above.
systemControl.resetUnconfirmed: Reset was not confirmed. Check for Setup first. If you verify that no reset is pending, reload this page before trying again.
systemControl.actionFailed: The system action could not be started.

state.application_separate_preparation: The archive can preserve the data. Automatic full restore will refuse to proceed because an active app needs separate preparation.
state.application_profile_unverified: Could not verify every active app’s restore profile during this check. A backup is not proof that all apps will restart.

backups.unchecked: Backup readiness has not been checked
backups.onDemand: Checking reads the files to estimate the backup. It only runs when you ask.
backups.appInventory: Application data included in this check
backups.inventoryScope: Current data files only. This check does not create an archive or verify a restore.
backups.noAppFiles: No application-owned files in this inventory.
backups.title: Backup and recovery
backups.description: Create encrypted local backups and restore this Standalone device to an earlier state.
backups.retention: The five newest backups are kept automatically on this device.
backups.operationRolledBack: Restore failed and previous state was recovered
backups.createConfirm: Type CREATE BACKUP to create an encrypted local backup.
backups.createQueued: Backup started. The application may be unavailable briefly; refresh after it returns.
backups.restoreConfirm: Type the shown RESTORE phrase to replace the current device data with this backup.
backups.restoreQueued: Restore started. The application may restart; reconnect and refresh after it returns.
backups.loadFailed: Backup information could not be loaded.
backups.disasterHelp: Download a password-protected recovery file and keep it away from this device. Use it after a new installation if the SD card fails.
backups.downloadConfirm: Create and download a portable recovery file? Keep both the file and its password safe.
backups.downloadReady: Recovery file downloaded. Store it and its password away from this device.
backups.restoreFileConfirm: Restore all application data from this file? The device will restart its services.
backups.passwordPrompt: Enter a recovery password with at least 8 characters.
backups.passwordTooShort: The recovery password must contain at least 8 characters.
backups.passwordMismatch: The recovery passwords do not match.

simple.title: Recent problems
simple.intro: Check what was observed in the last 15 minutes. Save the report if you need help.
simple.clearHelp: Clear recent Core errors and observations in this browser tab? New errors will still appear. Audit records and recordings are kept.
simple.clearFailed: Clearing was not confirmed. Check again before trying to clear history.
simple.full: The download includes all retained cases and their request identifiers.
simple.partial: Some checks did not return a result. This report is incomplete.
simple.none: No recent Core failure was retained. This is not a health guarantee.

storageSample.title: Who is writing to the Core database?
storageSample.help: Measure five seconds of new Core connections. No queries, values or identities are recorded.
storageSample.empty: No eligible writes were observed in this measurement.
storageSample.limit: Older connections and other processes are not measured. This is not proof of who blocked an earlier request.
storageSample.cooldown: A measurement is running or just finished. Wait a moment before measuring again.

cases.olderTiming: Timing and the last passed check were not retained for this request.
cases.latestTiming: Time and duration of the latest occurrence:

diagnostics.title: Support diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Review safe device checks and download a redacted JSON bundle for troubleshooting.
diagnostics.safeHelp: The bundle contains system metadata and health results, never passwords, keys, tokens, Wi-Fi profiles, database content or logs.

recent.title: Recent HTTP failures
recent.traceHelp: Match Trace ID with the X-3mm-Trace-Id response header in the browser Network tab. Selecting it also filters detailed records when available.
recent.help: Always-on, safe metadata: up to 100 failures for 15 minutes in this Core process memory. Restart clears it. Detailed recording is separate.
recent.failed: Recent failure observations are unavailable. Previously loaded rows may be stale.
recent.empty: No recent Core HTTP failures recorded. Requests that never reached Core are not included.
recent.limits: This is bounded history, not a complete audit. Omitted / expired records:
recent.unconfirmed: Execution unconfirmed — read the original outcome; do not resend
recent.unknown: Dispatch state not recorded — do not infer non-execution

workspace.title: Operation diagnostics
workspace.help: Trace a selected operation for a limited time. Diagnostics do not change execution permissions.
workspace.normal: Normal mode — detailed recording is off
workspace.expiry: Recording expires automatically. Restarting a component does not resume it.
workspace.safe: Only fixed metadata is recorded. Request bodies, files, terminal output, tokens and arbitrary logs are excluded.
workspace.imported: Imported records are a local snapshot, not live component state. Refresh clears this merge.
workspace.truncated: The display is limited. Export records for the complete bounded snapshot.
workspace.empty: No matching records. Start a session and perform the selected operation.
workspace.failed: Diagnostics are unavailable. Check your access and refresh observations.
workspace.tooLarge: Export exceeds the 4 MiB import limit.

reason.collector_busy: Another observation is in progress; refresh shortly
